technical.summary: MSI shows bullish technical structure with price above key MAs and rising RSI momentum, but weak trend strength (ADX 23.93), declining volume, and conflicting Hull MA signal limit conviction for a high-probability swing entry.

fundamental.summary: MSI shows no insider buying, no institutional accumulation, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and earnings in 85 days—insufficient fundamental or smart money support for conviction.

sentiment.summary: No actionable congressional signal; mixed retail sentiment (47% bearish) with neutral fear/greed index (51) provides no clear contrarian opportunity; insufficient data for conviction.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: inverted yield curve signals recession risk, VIX at crisis levels (268) indicates extreme market stress, and earnings in 85 days adds event risk; only DXY tailwind provides minor offset for IT multinational.

debate.key_bull_argument: Price above all major moving averages with rising RSI(9) momentum and StochRSI bullish cross provides technical structure for mean-reversion entry in oversold conditions.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels), zero fundamental support, weak trend strength (ADX 23.93), declining volume (0.65 ratio), and price near 52-week highs with earnings event risk in 85 days create asymmetric downside risk.

decision.entry_rationale: Technical structure shows price above major MAs with rising RSI momentum, but this is insufficient to overcome severe macro headwinds and zero fundamental support in a crisis VIX environment.
decision.primary_risk: Inverted yield curve + VIX crisis levels (268) + earnings event in 85 days create asymmetric downside risk; weak trend strength (ADX 23.93) and declining volume (0.65) suggest momentum is fragile.
decision.agent_agreement: strong — all agents aligned on bearish bias; technical score (7) insufficient to overcome fundamental (2), sentiment (5), and risk (2) consensus
